product.title: Epic Paracas & Huacachina - Day Trip From Lima

description.text: In Lima, this long guided day runs south to Islas Ballestas, an Ica wine and pisco tasting, and Huacachina for a two-hour dune-buggy and sandboarding window. Hotel or hostel pickup is listed for Barranco, Miraflores, and San Isidro, with bilingual guiding and a published 22-person cap. Boat time at Ballestas and the desert activity are included; meals and some rentals are listed separately on the product page. The route is aimed at visitors who want a single guided coastal-and-desert day without booking the boat, tasting room, and dunes independently. Sunset timing at Huacachina is listed with the dune-buggy window. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on Islas Ballestas, Ica, and Huacachina that define this outing rather than a Nazca overflight add-on.

highlights: Full-day route from Lima to Islas Ballestas, Ica, and Huacachina
Wine and pisco tasting in Ica
Two-hour dune-buggy and sandboarding window at Huacachina
Hotel or hostel pickup in Barranco, Miraflores, or San Isidro

start.description: Pickup is listed for Barranco, Miraflores, and San Isidro. A meeting point at Calle Porta 145, Miraflores 15074, Peru is published for other locations.

end.description: Return to your Lima meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
